# Dodge Labs

> Roger Mitchell runs Dodge Labs, a solo consultancy. The work is digital transformation for operators in growth and mid-market financial services, enterprise nonprofits, and professional services. Redesign the process before you automate it. Two ways to engage: Advisory (you own the decisions; he pressure-tests the path) and Projects (he diagnoses, designs, builds, and hands off something the team can run).

Dodge Labs has no employees and no subcontractors. This site is the practice, the Only Done Right newsletter, and a 30-minute intro call.

Only Done Right is a short email for operators, one idea at a time, on operational friction. The archive is the full set. The two newest essays are the current point of view: redesign before you automate, and keep skills and data portable instead of locking them into one vendor's AI front door.

## Site

- [Home](https://dodgelabs.com/): Who the work is for, and the split between Advisory and Projects.
- [About Roger Mitchell](https://dodgelabs.com/about/): Solo management consultant. Dodge Labs started in 2016. The work sits between business judgment and the technical build.
- [Subscribe to Only Done Right](https://dodgelabs.com/subscribe-to-newsletter/): Newsletter signup. Past issues are in the archive.
- [Schedule an intro call](https://dodgelabs.com/schedule-your-intro-call/): 45 minutes on Google Meet. No pitch deck and no obligation.
- [Newsletter archive](https://dodgelabs.com/newsletter/): Every Only Done Right essay, newest first.

## Essays

- [Leveraging Skills & The Frontier Firm](https://dodgelabs.com/newsletter/leveraging-skills-and-the-frontier-firm/): Use other people's skills instead of hoarding your own. Keep skills and data portable across Salesforce and HubSpot. Use AI as a sandbox, not a surveillance stack. 25 September 2026.
- [Clay Before Marble: Redesign, Then Automate](https://dodgelabs.com/newsletter/clay-before-marble-redesign-then-automate/): Redesign the process before you automate it. Iterate in clay before you commit to marble. 18 September 2026.
- [How to Decide Whether to Automate or Outsource](https://dodgelabs.com/newsletter/how-to-decide-whether-to-automate-or-outsource/): When hiring is off the table, automate repetitive standardized work and outsource varied creative work.
- [When Keeping Your Current Systems is the Best Move](https://dodgelabs.com/newsletter/when-keeping-your-current-systems-is-the-best-move/): A newer system, including a new AI tool, is not automatically the right move. Sometimes the current systems should stay.
